name: Victorious Life
overview: Scripture reveals that a victorious life is secured through the power and presence of God, who strengthens, helps, and upholds believers in every circumstance (Isaiah 41:10). Christians are no longer under the dominion of sin but live under grace, enabling them to overcome through Christ's love (Romans 6:14; Romans 8:37). This victory is expressed in a transformed mind and life, marked by faith in Christ who lives within, empowering believers to walk in God's perfect will and to triumph over Satan (Romans 12:2; Galatians 2:20; Romans 16:20).
